**Decision Note – Complaint AE-161126-0934**

**Liability: Zero liability – full reversal to customer.**
The unauthorised ₹19,600 Aadhaar-enabled withdrawal of 09.11.2026 resulted directly from the bank's deficiency: the branch accepted the 06.11.2026 block request (receipt BR-061126-118) but its control system failed to activate it. Under para 6(i) of RBI circular DBR.No.Leg.BC.78/09.07.005/2017-18, contributory fraud/negligence/deficiency on the bank's part entitles the customer to zero liability, **irrespective of reporting delay**. The 7-day delay in notification (SMS 09.11; first report 16.11) is therefore irrelevant. The counter staff's remark on a "7-day rule" applies only to third-party breaches (paras 7(ii)/Table 2) and is inapplicable. Burden of proof lies on the bank (para 12); no customer negligence found. The ₹21,000 supplier invoice is unrelated.

**Action & timelines:**
- Shadow reversal credit of ₹19,600 within **10 working days of notification (16.11.2026)** – i.e., by **30.11.2026** – value-dated 09.11.2026, without awaiting insurance settlement (para 9).
- Complete resolution and liability determination within **90 days** (by 14.02.2027) per Board-approved policy (para 10); no loss of interest to customer.

Corrective action on the block-request queue to be reported to the Standing Committee.

**Internal Note — ₹12,750 Debit Card CNP E-commerce Failure (A/c …4836, Ms. Neelima)**

**Failed transaction?** Yes. Under the circular, a failed transaction is one not fully completed due to reasons not attributable to the customer. Here the account was debited on T = Thursday, 19 Nov 2026, but confirmation never reached the merchant's system and no order was generated — this is a Card Not Present (e-commerce) failure (Table 3, Sl. 2c). The 18 Nov ₹1,860 purchase was successful and is excluded.

**Deadline:** Auto-reversal within T + 5 days for CNP transactions.

**Day count:** T = Thu 19 Nov; T+1 = Fri 20; T+2 = Sat 21; T+3 = Sun 22; T+4 = Mon 23; T+5 = Tue 24 Nov 2026. Deadline: 24 November 2026.

**Was reversal late?** Yes — funds reached the customer's account on Friday, 27 November 2026 (R), i.e., 3 days late (25, 26, 27 Nov).

**Compensation due:** ₹100 per day of delay × 3 days = **₹300**, to be credited suo moto without any claim form, per paragraph 5 of the circular. Customer may escalate to RBI-Integrated Ombudsman Scheme if not paid.

**Note on the ₹450 penal charge – circular compliance gaps (RBI/2023-24/53, 18 Aug 2023)**

The cooperative is a non-individual business borrower, so para 3(v)'s cap does not apply; the levy is otherwise within the circular's scope. The file shows clear breaches of the disclosure and communication requirements:

- Para 3(vi): the quantum and reason for the penal charge must be disclosed in the loan agreement, the applicable KFS, and on the website under Interest Rates and Service Charges. Here, none of the three states the amount for a late stock statement or the reason for it.
- Para 3(vii): the 13 November reminder should have communicated the applicable penal charge but mentioned only "charges"; the 17 November levy notice stated the amount but not the reason (the missing stock statement).
- Positively, para 3(i)–(ii) appear met: no penal interest was added to the rate and no interest was charged on the ₹450.

Correction needed: amend the agreement, KFS and website to state the quantum and reason, and re-issue communications with the required content. Board-approved policy and reasonableness (paras 3(iii)–(iv)) should also be verified; the file records no finding on whether ₹450 is reasonable.

On refund: the circular does not itself guarantee a refund. It sets disclosure and conduct requirements but contains no automatic-reversal rule; whether ₹450 is refunded depends on reasonableness and policy findings not established in this file.

Namaste! Aapke sawaalon ke jawab RBI circular ke hisaab se:

**1. Interest rate badha kar charge?** Nahi. Late stock report jaise non-compliance ke liye jo penalty lagti hai woh 'penal charges' ke roop mein hogi, 'penal interest' ke roop mein nahi. Rate of interest mein ise jodna allowed nahi hai, aur na hi interest rate mein koi additional component lagaya ja sakta hai.

**2. Penal charge par interest?** Nahi. Penal charges ko capitalise nahi kiya ja sakta, yaani us charge par aage koi interest nahi lagta. (Loan mein normal interest compounding as usual chalega.)

**3. Disclosure kahan?** Amount (quantum) aur reason dono loan agreement aur Key Fact Statement (KFS)/most important terms & conditions mein clearly hone chahiye, aur bank ki website par bhi "Interest rates and Service Charges" ke under display hona chahiye.

**4. Reminder mein kya?** Jab reminder bheja jata hai, tab applicable penal charges batana zaroori hai. Aur agar charge actually levy ho, tab charge ka amount aur reason bhi communicate karna hota hai.

**5. Dost wala point?** Woh rule individual borrowers ke "personal purpose" (non-business) loans par hai. Aapka loan business purpose ka hai, toh woh comparison aap par lagoo nahi hoga.

**6. 650 ki ceiling?** Circular mein koi fixed rupee amount ya percentage ceiling nahi di gayi. Sirf itna kehta hai ki charges reasonable hone chahiye, non-compliance ke commensurate, aur ek hi loan/product category mein discriminatory nahi. Bank ka quoted figure (650) bank ki Board-approved policy par depend karta hai; RBI ne 650 ko maximum fix nahi kiya hai.

मान्यवर, आपके मामले में RBI दिशानिर्देशों के अनुसार स्थिति इस प्रकार है:

**आपकी liability कितनी?**
यह तीसरे पक्ष की breach है जिसमें न बैंक की और न आपकी कमी है। नियम के अनुसार:
- 3 कार्यदिवस के भीतर शिकायत → शून्य liability
- 4–7 कार्यदिवस में → अधिकतम ₹10,000 (सामान्य बचत खाते के लिए)
- 7 कार्यदिवस से अधिक देरी → **बैंक की Board-approved policy के अनुसार**

आपको 2 नवंबर को सूचना मिली और शिकायत 13 नवंबर को की। आपकी home branch का कार्यक्रम गिनने पर (संचार मिलने की तारीख को छोड़कर, 8 नवंबर रविवार को छोड़ते हुए) यह देरी 7 कार्यदिवस से अधिक है। अतः सर्कुलर से कोई सटीक रुपया-राशि तय नहीं होती — **आपकी liability बैंक की Board-approved policy तय करेगी**, न कि "₹10,000 से कम" जैसी फोन पर कही गई बातें।

**Policy दिखाना जिम्मेदारी है?** हाँ। बैंक को यह policy खाता खोलते समय देनी होती है, website पर प्रदर्शित करनी होती है, और मौजूदा ग्राहकों को व्यक्तिगत रूप से सूचित करना अनिवार्य है। यह आपको तुरंत उपलब्ध कराएँ।

**सबूत कौन देगा?** ग्राहक की liability साबित करने का बोझ **पूरी तरह बैंक पर** है।

**अस्थायी credit:** शिकायत (13 नवंबर) के **10 कार्यदिवस** के भीतर shadow reversal करना होगा, और उसकी **value date 2 नवंबर 2026** (अनधिकृत transaction की तारीख) होगी।

**अंतिम फैसला:** बैंक की policy में तय समय में, पर **अधिकतम 90 दिन** के भीतर शिकायत सुलझाकर liability तय करनी होगी; न होने पर भी बकाया compensation देना होगा।

नमस्ते! आपका मामला PPI (wallet) का **On-Us transaction** है (दोनों wallet एक ही जारीकर्ता के भीतर), इसलिए circular के अनुसार reversal **T + 1 दिन** के भीतर होना चाहिए था।

- लेन-देन (T): सोमवार, 23 नवंबर 2026
- अंतिम तारीख (T+1): **मंगलवार, 24 नवंबर 2026**
- Reversal मिला: शुक्रवार, 27 नवंबर 2026
- देरी: 24 के बाद **3 दिन** (25, 26, 27 नवंबर)
- Compensation: ₹100 प्रति दिन × 3 = **₹300**

ध्यान दें:
1. **Compensation स्वतः (suo moto)** आपके wallet में डाला जाना चाहिए — आपको कोई नया claim भरने की ज़रूरत नहीं है।
2. T "calendar date" है, इसलिए शनिवार/रविवार को छोड़ा **नहीं** जाता; सभी दिन गिने जाते हैं।
3. इस circular में customer care का कोई telephone number **नहीं** दिया गया है।
